en: Color reproduction of a Renaissance painting of the Virgin Mary holding the Christ Child. Mary is shown half‑length, wearing a blue mantle and white veil, seated before a red curtain with a distant hilly landscape and a church or small town visible at the left. The infant Jesus stands on her lap, nude, leaning against her. Along the lower border of the image there is a small inscription with the painter's name.
